matthew.2.p1.b1.text: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod,

matthew.2.p1.b2.text: Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem,

matthew.2.p1.b3.text: Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews?

matthew.2.p1.b4.text: We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.

matthew.2.p2.b1.text: When King Herod heard this, he was disturbed,

matthew.2.p2.b3.text: And when he had assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people,

matthew.2.p2.b4.text: he asked them where the Christ was to be born.

matthew.2.p3.b1.text: In Bethlehem in Judea, … for this is what the prophet has written:

matthew.2.p3.b2.text: But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah,

matthew.2.p3.b3.text: for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.

matthew.2.p4.b1.text: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and learned from them the exact time the star had appeared.

matthew.2.p4.b2.text: Go and search carefully for the Child, and when you find Him, report to me,

matthew.2.p4.b3.text: so that I too may go and worship Him.

matthew.2.p5.b1.text: After they had heard the king, they went on their way,

matthew.2.p5.b2.text: and the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them

matthew.2.p5.b3.text: until it stood over the place where the Child was.

matthew.2.p5.b4.text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with great delight.

matthew.2.p6.b1.text: On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary,

matthew.2.p6.b2.text: and they fell down and worshiped Him.

matthew.2.p6.b3.text: Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.

matthew.2.p7.b1.text: And having been warned in a dream not to return to Herod,

matthew.2.p7.b2.text: they withdrew to their country by another route.

matthew.2.p7.b3.text: When the Magi had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream.

matthew.2.p7.b4.text: Get up! … Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. … for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.

matthew.2.p8.b2.text: took the Child and His mother by night, and withdrew to Egypt,

matthew.2.p8.b3.text: where he stayed until the death of Herod.

matthew.2.p8.b4.text: This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called My Son.”

matthew.2.p9.b1.text: When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was filled with rage.

matthew.2.p9.b2.text: Sending orders, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under,

matthew.2.p9.b3.text: Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled: “A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning,

matthew.2.p9.b4.text: Rachel weeping for her children, and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.

matthew.2.p10.b2.text: “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.”

matthew.2.p10.b4.text: took the Child and His mother, and went to the land of Israel.

matthew.2.p11.b1.text: But when he learned that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there.

matthew.2.p11.b2.text: And having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,

matthew.2.p11.b3.text: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth.

matthew.2.p11.b4.text: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Nazarene.”
